body.heading: Draw the path
paragraphs: With your adult, choose a safe paved place. Draw a winding path of stepping-stone circles.
Add picture instructions along the way: a star means twirl, a moon means tiptoe, a sun means hop.

body.heading: Walk your path
paragraphs: Follow your own path, doing what each picture says. Then let your adult try, and be the judge.
Chalk washes away in the rain, so your path is a picture that only lasts a little while.

takeaway: A plain path can become a game board as big as your garden.
safetyNotes: Draw only where your adult says it is allowed, away from roads; wash hands after chalk play.
screenFreeExtension: Draw a chalk hopscotch and teach a friend or a grandparent how to play.
